evidence_quote: For Al2O3 growth, the AlMe3 pulse and purge times were 0.1 and 4.0 s, respectively, followed by 0.1 and 4.0 s H2O pulse and purge steps. This reaction sequence was repeated for 500 cycles, leading approximately to 50 nm film.

In the TiO2 growth, the reactant pulse and purge times were also 0.1 and 4.0 s, respectively. In the TiO2 deposition, the number of pulse sequences was 1000 resulting in approximately 50 nm film thickness.
